name: facebook_proxy_revenue_per_global_ad_reachable_user_year
explanation: Meta 2025 advertising revenue divided by Facebook global advertising reach. This is a monetization proxy, not true Facebook-only revenue per user.

name: meta_ad_revenue_2025_proxy_for_facebook
explanation: Meta generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP = generally accepted accounting principles) advertising revenue for 2025. This covers Meta's advertising business across products and is used here only as a proxy for Facebook-level monetization.

name: meta_family_apps_arpp_2025_proxy
explanation: Average revenue per person (ARPP = average revenue per person) for Meta's Family of Apps in 2025. This includes Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, and other services, so it is a proxy rather than a Facebook-only value.

name: meta_total_revenue_2025_proxy_for_facebook
explanation: Meta total revenue for 2025. This is a broad ecosystem proxy and is not Facebook-only, so it should not be treated as platform-specific Facebook revenue.

name: snap_revenue_per_dau_year_2025

name: snap_revenue_per_mau_year_2025

name: snap_q4_revenue_2025

name: snap_total_revenue_2025

name: tiktok_global_ad_revenue_per_global_ad_reachable_user_year
